text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the first day of summer camp. We'll be starting a more rigorous routine to further improve performance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I can hear the sound of waves crashing… The ocean is so close by.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: To strengthen oneself in the midst of nature—it truly evokes the image of ascetic training. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, there is much to prepare for the Kikuka Sho and, before that, the Kobe Shimbun Hai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now, that's enough idle chitchat. Let's begin training right away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen and I enthusiastically begin our summer camp training.
